summary: The diff implements all six steps of Object.prototype.__defineSetter__ in order: ToObject(this) with `?`, IsCallable check throwing TypeError, PropertyDescriptor with set/enumerable/configurable true, ToPropertyKey(key) with `?` after the callable check, DefinePropertyOrThrow with `?`, and return undefined. Errors propagate with `?`, nothing is special-cased, and no made-up values are returned. The only non-spec change is renaming the unused `new_target` parameter to `_new_target`, which is needed because it is no longer used. The gate report shows 16 new passing test262 runs and no regressions.
notes_for_next_attempt: No defects found; all answers are no. The change can be merged as is. Only cosmetic point: the TypeError `return Err(...)` block is wrapped in a way rustfmt may reformat, which is not a correctness issue.
